newsitem.title: USA: Premark Q3 continuing operations sales up.
newsitem.headline: Premark Q3 continuing operations sales up.

text.p: Premark International Inc said Monday that, excluding revenues from its recently divested Hartco Flooring subsidiary, third quarter revenues rose nearly five percent.

Earlier, Premark reported third quarter sales of $563.2 million, up two percent from total sales a year ago of $556.3 million. Third quarter income of $0.46 a share rose from year-ago results from continuing operations of $0.41 a share .
Premark said continued record performance at Wilsonart led the rise in quarterly income.

Other contributing factors were increased demand in the service, institutional and supermarket channels of the domestic operations of the Food Equipment Group, as well as strong acceptance of new products at Precor.
These factors more than offset the continuing impacts of a weak U.S. retail environment and soft European economies.

"Our strength in the quarter reflects a favorable domestic economy for our largest core businesses, the Food Equipment Group and Wilsonart, as well as increased new product introductions and international expansion efforts," James Ringler, chief executive officer, said in a statement.

"Sales growth contnued at its historic rate, but we made progress toward our goal of 10 percent segment profit return on sales as a result of improved cost structures in each of our businesses," Ringler added. "Our outlook remains positive as we focus on accelerating growth opportunities and further reducing costs."
Premark makes a variety of consumer products with brand names such as Hobart, Wilsonart, West Bend, Florida Tile and Precor.
